description.zh: 一个守时的番茄钟：合上盖子再回来，时间还是对的；还能记今天做了多久
description.en: A pomodoro timer that keeps its place — and keeps today's total, too

help.zh: 0 表示不设目标。设了之后卡片上多一条进度：今天完成的专注分钟数 / 目标。
help.en: 0 means no goal. Above that a progress line appears: minutes focused today against the goal.

help.zh: 关着的时候每到一站就停下等你。
help.en: Off means the timer stops at each boundary and waits for you.

items.zh: 按钮上写开始（阶段还没动）、继续（停在一半）、暂停（正在跑）。
items.en: The button reads Start before the phase begins, Resume when you stopped halfway, Pause while it runs.

items.zh: 重置会把当前阶段恢复成整段时长并停下。
items.en: Reset puts the current phase back to its full length and stops it.

items.zh: 颜色和阶段名跟着状态走：专注、休息、长休息。
items.en: The colour and the label change with the phase: Focus, Break, Long break.

items.zh: 专注时长、休息时长和长休息时长是这三段的长短，都在属性面板里调。
items.en: Focus length, Break length and Long break length are the three durations, all set in the inspector.

items.zh: 「长休息间隔」数的是完成的轮次：4 就是先三次短休息，再来一次长的。
items.en: Long break after counts finished rounds: 4 means three short breaks and then a long one.

items.zh: 调成 0 就关掉长休息 —— 之后每次都只是短休息。
items.en: Set it to 0 to turn long breaks off — then every break is a short one.

items.zh: 右边那个小计数是这一轮循环里的第几个，比如 2 / 4。
items.en: The small counter reads which round of the cycle you are in, e.g. 2 / 4.

items.zh: 「自动开始下一阶段」关着的时候，每到一站就停下等你。
items.en: Start the next phase automatically off means the timer stops at every boundary and waits for you.

items.zh: 默认关着是故意的：自己开始的休息，不是你决定要歇的那一次。
items.en: That is the default on purpose: a break that starts itself is a break you did not decide to take.

items.zh: 打开之后，它会从专注直接滚进休息、再滚回来，直到你按暂停。
items.en: On, it rolls straight from focus into break and back until you pause.

items.zh: 存的是「什么时候结束」，不是「还剩多久」—— 睡眠、合盖或重启都不吃掉一分钟。
items.en: The timer stores the moment it will end, not the time left — sleeping, closing the lid or restarting loses no minutes.

items.zh: 睡着的这段时间里到点的阶段，回来的那一刻就算结束，而不是重新开始。
items.en: A phase that ended while the machine was asleep is finished the moment it comes back, not restarted.

items.zh: 只有暂停着的阶段才存剩余时间，所以继续能接着刚才那儿走。
items.en: Only a paused phase stores a remaining time, which is why Resume continues where you left off.

items.zh: 在属性面板里把「每日目标」调成一个分钟数（比如 120），卡片上就多一条进度。
items.en: Set Daily goal to a number of minutes in the inspector (120, say) and a progress line appears.

items.zh: 数的是今天完成的专注轮次；休息不算，跳过的那一轮也不算。
items.en: It counts rounds of focus finished today: breaks do not count, and a round you skipped does not either.

items.zh: 分钟数按现在的专注时长折算，所以改时长会让今天的历史跟着重算。
items.en: Minutes are worked out from the focus length you have now, so changing that length re-counts today.

items.zh: 跨过午夜自动归零：设了目标时它每分钟看一眼日期，没设就一分钟也不多醒。
items.en: It resets at midnight: with a goal set it checks the date once a minute, and without one it never wakes up early.

items.zh: 它们是同一个计时器的两个视图：在一个上按开始，另一个跟着动。
items.en: They are two views of one timer: start on one and the other follows.

items.zh: 两个在同一毫秒到点也接得住 —— 这一轮只记一次，不记两次。
items.en: Both reaching the end in the same millisecond is handled — the round is recorded once, not twice.

items.zh: 完成记录只留最近 20 轮，文件不会一直长下去。
items.en: The history of finished rounds is capped at the last 20, so the file cannot grow without limit.

changes.zh: 可以设每日目标：卡片上多一条进度，写「今日 50 / 120 分钟」，达标换成强调色。
changes.en: A daily goal is available: a progress line reading Today 50 / 120 min, turning accent-coloured when met.

changes.zh: 数字按今天完成的专注轮次折算（休息不算），跨过午夜自动归零。
changes.en: The number comes from focus rounds finished today (breaks excluded) and resets at midnight.

changes.zh: 大字时间跟着卡片高度缩，矮卡片上也放得下这一条。
changes.en: The big digits scale with the card height so the goal line still fits on a short card.

changes.zh: 界面和说明都支持中文了：阶段名、按钮、提示和说明都跟着平台的语言走。
changes.en: Interface and help are bilingual now: the phase names, buttons, hints and help follow the platform language.

changes.zh: 第一个版本：专注、短休息和长休息，带一个按轮计数的计数器。
changes.en: First release: focus, short break and long break, with a per-cycle counter.

changes.zh: 按结束时刻记时，所以睡眠或合上盖子都不丢分钟。
changes.en: Keeps time by storing the end moment, so sleeping or closing the lid does not lose minutes.

changes.zh: 两个组件步调一致；两边同时到点也只记一轮。
changes.en: Two widgets stay in step; a round is recorded once even when both finish together.
